inventory.inventory_digest: SHA-256 of canonical JSON encoding of the inventory object without a terminal newline
inventory.manifest_digest: SHA-256 of the complete canonical contents document including its terminal newline
inventory.main_executable_architecture: Validated from PE, ELF, or Mach-O headers and required to include declared target_arch
inventory.zero_byte_directory_members: Recorded with size 0 and the SHA-256 digest of empty content
inventory.symlinks: Relative file and directory symlinks are recorded with path, raw target, target kind, and resolved in-tree path; they are revalidated after tree traversal
reject: symbolic link or junction in a root or ancestor
absolute, escaping, broken, non-file-or-directory, unrecorded, cyclic, or concurrently changed symlink
product or inventory root resolving outside the repository
